I helped pass the No Surprises Act to protect Americans from unexpected medical bills from out-of-network providers.  The new law bans surprise billing for most emergency care and provides health care cost information to uninsured and self-pay patients. https://t.co/kDT6BpAJ5p

Today is American #Diabetes Alert Day!  More than 30 million Americans suffer from diabetes.  As a diabetic, I fight to improve treatment and lower the cost of insulin every day.  To learn more about the risk, click here —-> https://t.co/OubmjOSprb https://t.co/KSObSwBOH1

March is National Nutrition Month!  I’ve included a website to learn how to participate in cooking demonstrations, health screenings, and fitness classes. Please visit: https://t.co/yWLZFxNPvs https://t.co/qNDBFc5DHE

March is National Nutrition Month.  Nearly two-thirds of American adults are overweight or obese.  Obesity leads to heart disease, stroke, type 2 diabetes, and cancer.  This month is the perfect time to improve your diet and your health.  #NationalNutritionMonth https://t.co/5BgjwOysh3

I was proud to celebrate the opening of the South Ward Wellness Center today.  It is a great facility that will benefit the almost 60,000 residents of Newark’s South Ward as well as the greater Newark community. https://t.co/OE2D2gMpbS

During National Financial Literacy Month, New Jersey wants to help you create more financial security with a financial wellness website. 
 
Find out how to save more and how your personality could affect your spending at https://t.co/8PYLrRRoDW https://t.co/ki0LQlEcfJ

I always enjoy visiting the local businesses in my district.  Today, I met with Prakash Maddali, a pharmacist and owner of E&M Pharmacy in East Orange, to discuss small business healthcare and neighborhood improvement. https://t.co/lcVtYUg1pD

Federal firefighters lack health coverage for long-term, work-related health problems (like lung and brain cancer) suffered years after their service.  I helped pass a bill today (Firefighters Fairness Act - H.R. 2499) to give them that coverage. https://t.co/8MHRrTIfVu
I found out I tested positive for COVID-19 yesterday.  I'm feeling fine with no symptoms!  Thank God I had the vaccine and both my booster shots or this could be a lot worse! https://t.co/O3PenG0Tyh

As we enter Pride Month in June, I enjoyed being at RWJ University Hospital Rahway’s Pride Flag raising and celebration today.  The hospital was recognized as a Leader in LGBTQ+ Healthcare by the Human Rights Campaign- the highest designation a hospital can receive from it. https://t.co/MDhTOikLJQ

Today, I plan to vote for the Keep Kids Fed Act of 2022 to help schools feed students during the summer and next year.  We have to do everything we can to help our students learn and succeed.

https://t.co/Wefv5MvEDN https://t.co/JYEKNEFCWG

September is Peripheral Artery Disease Awareness Month.  #PAD starts with mild symptoms, but can result in a limb amputation.  I started the Congressional PAD Caucus to create awareness of this disease and increase screenings to save limbs and lives. #PADAwarenessMonth https://t.co/4OwvctdhZs

I am outraged by the photos of Mr. Kastellio Vaughn, an inmate at the Elmore Correctional Facility in Alabama. I will be writing a letter to the (DOJ) @CivilRights to investigate his treatment and other prisoners at the facility. 

No human being should ever be treated this way.

The House Republican agenda will slash Medicare and take away the ability for the federal government to negotiate lower drugs prices.

Our Seniors should never have to choose between powering their lights on or being able to afford their medication. #PeopleOverPolitics

The @HouseGOP wants to gut Medicare and Social Security. They want to privatize @SocialSecurity, raise the retirement age to 70 and end Medicare as we know it.

@HouseDemocrats fought for this historic increase in  benefits because we believe in putting #PeopleOverPolitics.

NJ-10, it's officially Health Insurance Open Enrollment Season!

If you wish to re-enroll in your existing health insurance plan, shop and compare plans, or enroll for the first time, please visit @GetCoveredNJ  (https://t.co/BytIzZvmRa) or call 1-833-677-1010 to explore options.

Republicans in Congress want put Social Security and Medicare on the chopping block. 

They are obsessed with extreme social issues, banning abortion nationwide, and an ultra-MAGA agenda. 

https://t.co/P198GdYFhN
If Republicans get their way millions of Americans will lose health care coverage, benefits, and other long-held protections.

If Republicans get their way tens of millions of Americans could see their health insurance and retirement or disability benefits at risk (63 million Medicare beneficiaries, 89 million Medicaid beneficiaries, and 65 million Social Security beneficiaries).

If Republicans in Congress get their way, they will: 
❌Double down on Trump’s massive tax cuts
❌Do Big Pharma’s bidding & raise drug prices
❌Increase health care costs
❌Cancel student debt relief
❌Threaten the global economy to cut Social Security/Medicare

Every single Republican in Congress voted against:
❌Giving Medicare the power to negotiate prescription drug prices
❌Capping out-of-pocket prescription drug costs for seniors at $2,000 a year
❌Capping insulin costs for seniors at $35 a month

I want to send my heartfelt thanks to NJ-10 voters for re-electing me to serve as their representative in Congress. I'll continue to fight for affordable healthcare, lower inflation, increased jobs, more equality, and an end to gun violence for all Americans. https://t.co/6VfZoJpGnv
